definitions.gloss: giving up; abandoning a plan or hope
definitions.explanation: The act of reluctantly letting go of something one had hoped for or planned. Implies a deliberate decision to stop pursuing a goal, often after considerable effort or thought.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{断念|だんねん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gave up on studying abroad.

examples.japanese: {資金不足|しきんぶそく}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{断念|だんねん}⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Due to lack of funds, we had no choice but to abandon the plan.

examples.japanese: {怪我|けが}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦{出場|しゅつじょう}→出場：03223_shutsujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{断念|だんねん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are quite a few athletes who had to give up competing in the Olympics due to injury.

notes:
{断念|だんねん} means to reluctantly give up on a plan, goal, or hope. It implies a deliberate decision after considerable thought or effort.

FORMS:
{断|だん} (cut, sever) + ⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧ (thought, wish)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{断念|だんねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give up on ~
- {断念|だんねん}⟦せざる→する：00392_suru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧: to have no choice but to give up
- {断念|だんねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}い{込|こ}まれる→追い込む：06371_oikomu⟧: to be forced to give up

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧: to give up, resign oneself (more general, less formal)
- {断念|だんねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to abandon a plan (formal, for significant decisions)

{断念|だんねん} is typically used for weighty matters — career plans, life goals, projects. ⟦{諦|あきら}める→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧ is broader and works for both trivial and serious situations.

REGISTER:
Formal. Common in news and written Japanese.
